name: Voodoo Dolls
summary: Two-handed technique that creates small hand-held copies ('dolls') of distant objects to select and manipulate them at multiple scales.
howItWorks: The user pinches an object through the image plane to create a doll of it, then holds and moves dolls with both hands; changes to the doll apply to the full-size object.

relationships.note: Both work through hand-held proxies of distant objects.
